items.title: Alibaba ships Qwen4-Max as a closed model: 2.4T MoE, 1M-token context
items.why: Qwen's flagship stops shipping weights, so your local-model options now trail the API frontier.

items.title: Cursor says a vendor's leaked key led to a backdoored Claude Code extension
items.why: An AI editor's marketplace served malware for 11 hours. Worth auditing what your extensions can do.

items.title: Rust 1.100 stabilises the never type after ten years of attempts
items.why: You can finally name ! in types like Result<T, !>, and the Allocator trait lands for custom allocators.

items.title: llama.cpp tags v1.0.0 and removes 35 deprecated functions
items.why: The local-inference library you build against now has a stable surface, but old calls will break.

items.title: XRAID puts declustered-parity RAID inside XFS, claiming 20x faster writes
items.why: A filesystem absorbing the RAID layer is a clean case study in where an abstraction boundary costs you.

items.title: SPEC CPU2026 study: the compiler version alone can double a benchmark's IPC
items.why: Read before you benchmark anything: their SimPoint sampling error reached 43% on non-steady workloads.

items.title: India signs a ten-country declaration on AI and chip supply chains
items.why: The Pax Silica working groups will shape which AI hardware and tooling actually reaches Indian engineers.

items.title: India opens consent-manager registration under the DPDP Act
items.why: If a side project collects data from Indian users, consent plumbing is now a legal requirement, not a nicety.

items.title: LangChain raises $300M at a $3B valuation, with 7,000 orgs on LangSmith
items.why: Agent tracing is turning into paid infrastructure, which is worth weighing before you commit to a stack.

items.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI's agents check out using payment tokens
items.why: The pattern to study is the token standing in for the card number, not the shopping demo around it.

items.title: Sounds timed to slow brain waves raised spinal-fluid flow in 14 sleepers
items.why: Mechanism only: no memory or sleep-quality gain was measured, so there is nothing to change tonight.
